Context: 8. Pensionary terms for Central Government Employees absorbed consequent on conversion of Departments into Autonomous Body or a PSU

9. PSU/AB.
15. Dismissal or removal of any absorbed employee by the'PSU/ AB after his absorption will not forfeit his Retirement Benefits for his service in the Government up to the date of absorption. Such dismissal/removal will also be subject to confirmation by the Administrative Ministry concerned.
